scientific_limitations: Finite positive-mean iid renewal intervals and instantaneous Gaussian redraws for one-dimensional Ornstein–Uhlenbeck relaxation. Endpoint symmetrized KL is a coarse-grained information benchmark, not path-space entropy production or full reset work. The burst-like optimum is a supremum, not attained under strictly positive dwell times. No result for constrained dwell times or anharmonic dynamics.
title: Sharp renewal-clock envelope for Gaussian endpoint divergence
